objective_for_doctor:
Age: 30
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have a fever, a cough, and sensitive pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi doctor. I’ve had a fever and a cough, and I’m having sensitive, sharp pain related to all of this. The pain is about 6/10, and it feels very localized around 8/10, and it started pretty fast—like within a short time. Also, my mood has been unstable since this started.

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. To narrow down the cause of the fever + cough + sharp pain, **one question at a time**:

**1) Where exactly is the pain located (chest, throat, side/flank, abdomen, ear), and does it worsen with breathing in (deep breath) or coughing?**
The pain feels mostly in my ear area, and it’s very sensitive and sharp. It gets worse when I cough and when I try to take a deep breath.

Thanks—ear-area pain that worsens with coughing/deep breaths suggests a pleuritic process or referred pain.

**2) Do you have any trouble swallowing, drooling, muffled “hot potato” voice, or a feeling of throat swelling?**
No, I don’t have trouble swallowing, drooling, or a muffled voice. I don’t feel like my throat is swelling.

Okay.

**3) Is the pain on one side or both sides (left vs right), and do you have any ear symptoms like ear fullness, hearing loss, or ear drainage?**
It feels mainly on one side, and I also have ear symptoms—like fullness and some hearing feeling a bit off. No ear drainage.

Got it.

**4) How old are you, and do you have any recent upper-respiratory symptoms (runny nose, sore throat) or have you been sick with a cold recently?**
I’m 30. And yes, I’ve had some cold-like symptoms—cough and fever—and maybe a sore throat/runny nose type thing, but the main thing is the fever and cough.

Thanks.

**5) What’s your highest measured temperature (or approximate), and how long ago did the fever start?**
I don’t have the exact number, but it’s been a real fever—started about a day or so before I came in.

Understood.

**6) Any shortness of breath, wheezing, or feeling like you can’t get enough air?**
No, I’m not really short of breath or wheezing. It’s more the pain with coughing and deep breaths.
**7) Any chest pain that’s more central (breastbone) or is it truly localized to the ear/side area?**
It’s truly localized to my ear/side area more than the center of my chest.
**8) Do you have any rash, or have you noticed blisters/skin changes on that side of the face/ear area?**
No rash and no blisters or skin changes that I’ve noticed.
**9) Any recent dental pain, jaw pain, or pain when opening your mouth?**
No dental pain or jaw pain, and no pain when I open my mouth.
**10) Any severe headache, neck stiffness, or pain behind the ear with turning your head?**
No severe headache or neck stiffness. I do have pain around the ear area, but not really with turning my head.
**11) Have you had any ear infection symptoms before (history of otitis media), or is this the first time?**
This is the first time I’m dealing with something like this—no prior ear infection history that I know of.
**12) Are you able to take a deep breath without feeling like you’ll cough, and does the pain feel “sharp” like a stitch rather than pressure?**
I can take a deep breath, but it makes me cough, and yes it feels sharp—like a stitch.
**13) Any blood in your sputum, leg swelling/pain, recent long travel, or recent surgery?**
No blood in my sputum. No leg swelling or leg pain, and no recent long travel or surgery.
**14) Any heart symptoms—palpitations, fainting, or known heart/lung conditions (asthma/COPD/heart disease)?**
No palpitations, fainting, or known heart or lung conditions like asthma/COPD.
[DDX] Acute otitis media, Pneumonia, Acute COPD exacerbation / infection, Pulmonary embolism, Acute laryngitis
